description: This file defines a FastAPI router for managing workouts within a fitness application. It includes schemas for request and response models, endpoints for creating, listing, updating, and retrieving workout records, coupled with role-based access control. It interacts with database models (Workouts, Users) via SQLAlchemy and supports pagination and filtering.

classes.name: WorkoutCreateRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new workout, including member ID, date, workout type, duration, and optional notes.

classes.name: WorkoutResponse
classes.description: Schema for returning workout data, including ID, user ID, date, type, duration, and notes.

classes.name: WorkoutListResponse
classes.description: Schema for paginated list of workouts, including total count, current page, page size, and list of workout items.

classes.name: WorkoutPatchRequest
classes.description: Schema for partial updates to a workout, allowing optional modifications of date, type, duration, and notes.

methods.name: WorkoutResponse create_workout( payload: WorkoutCreateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new workout assigned to a member, accessible to trainers and admins.

methods.name: WorkoutListResponse list_my_workouts( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), page: conint(ge=1) = Query(1, description="Page number (1-based)"), page_size: conint(ge=1, le=100) = Query(20, description="Page size (1-100)"), from_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Filter: date >= from_date"), to_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Filter: date <= to_date"), )
methods.description: Retrieves paginated workouts for the current user with optional date filtering.

methods.name: WorkoutListResponse list_member_workouts( user_id: int = Path(..., description="Member user id"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), page: conint(ge=1) = Query(1, description="Page number (1-based)"), page_size: conint(ge=1, le=100) = Query(20, description="Page size (1-100)"), from_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Filter: date >= from_date"), to_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Filter: date <= to_date"), )
methods.description: Lists workouts for a specific member, accessible to trainers and admins, with pagination and optional date filters.

methods.name: WorkoutListResponse workout_history( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), page: conint(ge=1) = Query(1, description="Page number (1-based)"), page_size: conint(ge=1, le=100) = Query(20, description="Page size (1-100)"), from_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Filter: date >= from_date"), to_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Filter: date <= to_date"), )
methods.description: Provides paginated workout history for the current user, refactoring the 'list_my_workouts' endpoint.

methods.name: WorkoutResponse patch_workout( id: int = Path(..., description="Workout ID"), payload: WorkoutPatchRequest = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Partially updates a workout's details. Only the owner (member) or trainers/admins can modify.
